sentences.text: On the complaint lodged by Smt. Nazima W/o Basheer Khan dated 11.11.2022, Udayagiri Police had registered FIR in Crime No.173/2022 against the petitioner and another.
In the complaint it is averred that, complainant's daughter Smt. Taranum Khanam was married to the petitioner on 21.07.2019.
At the time of marriage, the complainant's family members allegedly had given dowry to the petitioner and his family members.
As per their demands, they had also given gold jewelry worth Rs.6,50,000/-.

It is alleged in the complaint that even thereafter the petitioner and his family members NC: 2023:KHC:29006 were ill-treating the complainant's daughter Taranum Khanam and had asked her to bring additional dowry.
About 3 to 4 months prior to the date of complaint, the complainant's daughter had come home and complained that the petitioner and his family members were ill-treating her.
In this regard, panchayath was also held and thereafter complainant's daughter had gone back to her matrimonial house.
On 11.11.2022, the complainant's younger sister informed her that her daughter had died in the petitioner's house.
Immediately, complainant went to the house of the petitioner.
Thereafter, lodged a complaint, which had resulted in registration of FIR in Crime No.173/2022.
The petitioner was arrested on 11.11.2022.
The police after completion of investigation have filed charge sheet against the accused persons.
The bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C, filed by the petitioner before the Court of V Addl. Sessions Judge, Mysuru in Crl.Misc.No.604/2023 was dismissed on 05.04.2023.

sentences.text: It is under these circumstances, the petitioner is before this court.

4. Learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and he has been wrongly implicated in a case for the offence punishable NC:
2023:KHC:29006 under Section 302 of IPC.
He submits that the deceased has not sustained any injury on her body.
The postmortem report would go to show that cause of death was head injury but no external injury is found in the body of the deceased.
There is no mention about any internal injury also in postmortem report.
The petitioner is a person without any criminal antecedents and he is in custody for last more than 9 months.

Investigation in the case is completed and the charge Janab Syed Umar vs State Of Karnataka on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141732607/
2 sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: Hence, he prays to allow the petition.

5. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent - State has opposed the bail application and submits that there are sufficient materials on record to connect the petitioner to crime.
In the complaint itself it is stated that, the deceased was ill-treated by the petitioner and his family members.
The dead body was found in the house of the petitioner and therefore, there is a presumption as against him.
Accordingly, she prays to dismiss the petition.

6. From the perusal of complaint averments it is seen that, there are certain allegations with regard to demand made by the accused persons for dowry and also about harassment NC:
2023:KHC:29006 meted out on the deceased by the accused persons.
It is also stated in the complaint that the dispute was settled in the panchayath and thereafter the deceased had gone back to her matrimonial house.
There is no mention of any specific incident that had taken place in the house of the petitioner after the deceased had gone back to matrimonial house subsequent to settlement between parties.
7. The material on record would go to show that on the date of incident, the deceased had gone to her room after coming to know that the petitioner had came back home.
The dead body of the petitioner was found lying on the bed inside the room beside her child, aged about 11 months.
Undisputedly, no injuries are found on the body of the deceased.

The postmortem report states that,
the death is caused as a result of head injury to the deceased, but there is no mention of any external or internal injury on the head of the deceased in the postmortem report.
None of the prosecutions witnesses have stated about any assault made by the accused on the deceased on the date of incident.
It is not disputed by the learned HCGP that the petitioner has no criminal antecedents.
The petitioner is in custody since 11.11.2022.
The NC: 2023:KHC:29006 investigation in the case is completed and the charge sheet has been filed.
The petitioner has a small child, which was aged about 11 months as on the date of incident.
Under these circumstances, I am of the considered view that the petitioner's prayer for grant of regular bail is required to be allowed.
In view of the above, the petition is allowed.
